**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** Monthly nursing journal covering psychosocial/mental-health nursing practice broadly: psychopharmacology (dedicated section, 6x/year), aging/older-adult mental health ("Aging Matters", 3x/year), substance use/addictive disorders ("Substance Abuse and Related Disorders", 2x/year), child/adolescent mental health ("Youth in Mind", 2x/year), plus general research, review, policy, and brief-report articles. It does publish AI-related content when framed as nursing-practice-relevant: e.g. a June 2025 bibliometric review "AI-Augmented Psychosocial Interventions: A Bibliometric Review and Implications for Nursing" (Vol 63, Issue 6) synthesizing AI/ML, chatbot, and CBT-personalization research trends for nursing implications.

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** quantitative research, qualitative research, mixed-methods research, scoping/integrative/systematic reviews, bibliometric review, policy articles, brief reports

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review/preprint.allowed**: No preprint-policy text was retrievable — journals.healio.com blocked WebFetch with HTTP 403 and search snippets only referenced that the SLACK Author Hub 'addresses' preprint handling without stating the actual rule (allowed/restricted/embargo).
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No SciRev entry found for this journal (searches for scirev.org + journal name returned zero matching results), and no forum thread stated a desk-reject percentage.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: Zero results on muchong.com, zhihu, and Reddit r/AskAcademia specifically naming this journal — no first-hand reviewer-culture accounts found in either language, so left null per HARD RULES rather than inferring a generic narrative.
- **ai_policy detail (exact leniency wording / permission-gate mechanics)**: The primary source page (journals.healio.com/slack-author-hub and journals.healio.com/journal/jpn/information-for-authors) returned HTTP 403 on direct WebFetch; the policy summary here is reconstructed from Google-indexed search-result snippets of that same page plus one corroborating third-party audit (PMC11869395) that only confirms a policy exists without detailing it. Treat the leniency=2 rating as a moderate-confidence inference (ban-on-authorship + mandatory disclosure = restrictive-but-not-total-ban), not a directly read policy chart.
